The '''Deflarians''' were a group of criminals who operated on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were named after their leader, [[Deflaros]].

==History==
{{Quote|Why are Deflarian scavengers poking around the wreckage? They are a well known criminal organization. Perhaps they are involved somehow.|[[Sinis]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CaB" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a traitorous [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] agent named [[Jori]] sold to the criminals known as the [[Ragtags]] information concerning a cargo of weapons carried to the local CorSec force in [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]]. Lacking firepower to perform themselves the thief, the Ragtags hired the Deflarians to hijack [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Donovan (captain)|Donovan's]] ship and steal the cargo of weapons.<ref name="SWG:LtBB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Let the Buyer Beware|Corellia}}</ref> The Deflarians succeeded the operation and captured the ship. Donovan was then imprisoned in the [[Deflarian bunker]].<ref name="SWG:WHtD" /> The Deflarians then crashed a ship of the same model than Donovan's to cover the theft of the cargo.<ref name="SWG:DC" /> After the crash, they also planned to place a modified flight recorder in the wreckage.<ref name="SWG:CaB" />

[[File:DonovanCrash-SWG.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The crash site.]]
However, Captain Donovan was also carrying medical equipment for the merchant [[Sinis]]. Sinis thus recruited a spacer to investigate the ship crash site and retrieve some equipment. Unfortunately for the Deflarians, the spacer spotted them while they were placing the modified flight recorder in the wreckage. The spacer fought the Deflarian scavengers and recovered the flight recorder. One of Sinis' friend, [[Yorick]], was later able to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] the flight recorder and discover that it was modified. The spacer later attacked the [[Deflarian Communications Post]] to find information. This led the spacer to another camp were the spacer defeated a Deflarian lieutenant and his enforcers, and finally retrieved Sinis's medical equipment. Sinis later transmitted all the information gathered about the Deflarians to [[Inspector/Legends|Inspector]] [[Cora (Human)|Cora]] of the CorSec.<ref name="SWG:CaB" />

[[File:Donovan_ship.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Deflarians guarding Donovan's true ship.]]
Inspector Cora therefore ordered the spacer to return to the Deflarian camp. From a scan of the area, Cora identified a courier who was used by the Deflarians for deliveries between camps. The spacer followed the courier until they arrived to the [[Deflarian bunker]]. The spacer infiltrated the bunker and found the imprisoned Captain Donovan. The spacer therefore killed [[Vinros]], several Deflarian henchmen and a Deflarian underboss to liberate Donovan.<ref name="SWG:WHtD" /> After Donovan revealed that his ship was hijacked, Cora tasked spacers to assault another Deflarian camp, whose location was provided by Donovan. During the raid, the spacers killed several Deflarian guards and mechanics, as well as Deflaros and his bodyguards, and secured Donovan's ship and its cargo.<ref name="SWG:DC" />

Furthermore, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jark]] of the CorSec later identified Agent Jori as the traitor who sold Captain Donovan to the Deflarians and the Ragtags. Jark thus sent spacers to raid a meeting between Deflarians and Ragtags, and Jori was killed during the operation.<ref name="SWG:LtBB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Deflarians appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CaB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Deflarians were added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>
